basics.name: Shourav Misro
basics.headline: Detail-oriented Software Quality Assurance Engineer with hands-on experience in manual testing, API testing, regression testing, and test automation using Playwright.

about.short: Detail-oriented Software Quality Assurance Engineer with hands-on experience in manual testing, API testing, regression testing, and test automation using Playwright. Skilled in designing and executing test plans, validating REST APIs, documenting defects, and ensuring software quality throughout the SDLC using Agile methodologies.
about.long: Detail-oriented Software Quality Assurance Engineer with hands-on experience in manual testing, API testing, regression testing, and test automation using Playwright. Skilled in designing and executing test plans, validating REST APIs, documenting defects, and ensuring software quality throughout the SDLC using Agile methodologies. On the embedded side, I also have experience with microcontrollers (ESP32, Arduino), sensor integration, communication protocols, and system validation.

projects.title: LearnLink LMS
projects.summary: Designed and executed 50+ manual test cases covering authentication, course management, enrollment, dashboard, REST API, and database workflows. Performed REST API testing using Postman, validated 500+ SQL records, and reported 20+ defects.

projects.title: Local Business Directory
projects.summary: Conducted functional testing and database validation for listing, search, filtering, and backend consistency across user scenarios. Prepared structured test scenarios and defect reports.

projects.title: Root Android
projects.summary: Conducted manual, usability, and regression testing for mobile e-commerce workflows including product browsing, cart, checkout, and payment interactions. Identified UI and usability issues and verified fixes.

projects.title: Hospital Management System
projects.summary: Designed and executed functional and regression test cases for patient, appointment, record management, CRUD operations, and backend business logic. Validated input handling, data integrity, and SQL database consistency.

projects.title: Intelligent Solar Panel System
projects.summary: Developed a smart energy optimization system with real-time monitoring, protection, and automated control (Published at IEEE CS BDC Summer Symposium 2025). Performed system testing, data validation, sensor accuracy verification, and performance analysis.

projects.title: Unified Smart Home Ecosystem
projects.summary: Developed an ESP32 and Raspberry Pi smart home system with sensor acquisition, motion interrupts, MQTT communication, and real-time automation logic.

projects.title: Traffic Management System
projects.summary: Built a real-time ESP32-based edge decision system using sensor data processing and low-latency firmware logic for traffic-related automation.

projects.title: Smart Security System
projects.summary: An Arduino-based security project with sonar, keypad, GSM, and Wi-Fi based real-time alerting and tracking features.

projects.title: Affordable Prosthetic Hand
projects.summary: Designed and developed a low-cost 3D-printed prosthetic hand prototype with basic mechanical actuation to assist physically disabled individuals in daily activities.

projects.title: Personal Dashboard
projects.summary: A cloud-deployed personal dashboard web application built with Python and Flask, focused on organizing and visualizing personal data through a clean interface.

projects.title: Underground Racing iGraphic
projects.summary: Graphics-focused university project related to game-style visual work and implementation.

experience.title: QA Intern
highlights: Designed and maintained Test Plans, Test Cases, RTM, Risk Matrix, Test Data, and QA documentation for requirement-based testing.
Executed manual, API, regression, integration, and database validation testing across reward, discount, eligibility, configuration, and user workflow scenarios.
Validated business rules, REST API responses, database consistency, edge cases, and cross-module workflows to ensure software reliability.
Reported and tracked defects in Jira with detailed reproduction steps, logs, severity, priority, screenshots, and validation notes.
Developed and maintained Playwright automation scripts for regression testing of critical application workflows.
